name: supervisor-worker
context: Complex work exceeding one agent's context or skill breadth: a supervisor decomposes the goal, routes subtasks to specialized worker agents, aggregates results, and decides completion.
tradeoffs: Supervisor is a bottleneck and failure point
use_cases: Content pipeline with outline, writing, editing
Research: spawn 3-5 subagents for parallel web search, synthesize findings
anti_patterns: No circuit breaker - one failing worker blocks entire pipeline
design_principles: One worker failing should not crash session - per-worker retry and circuit breakers
best_practices: Summarize worker results at handoff points when round trips exceed 5-8 to prevent context saturation
Hard-cap delegation depth at 3 levels to prevent runaway loops
Implement per-worker retry and circuit breakers for fault isolation
references: Wu et al., AutoGen: Enabling Next-Gen LLM Applications via Multi-Agent Conversation, 2023 — https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.08155
